usedFor: Unbounce captures landing page leads, and HubSpot receives each lead as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Arrives” in Unbounce, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each landing page lead opens a HubSpot deal, so sales can follow it from day one.

watchOut: “New Lead Arrives” is polling, so the deal is created after a scheduled check.
